landing.heroSub: OCR, liveness detection, face comparison and data validation — embedded with a URL, no native SDKs, ready in minutes.
landing.servicesTitle: Each verification, its own piece — combine them based on the risk of each flow.
landing.service1Desc: Extracts name, number, dates and nationality from any ID card, passport or license — with automatic validation that the image is a real document.
landing.service2Desc: Confirms there is a real person in front of the camera, not a photo or a screen playing a video.
landing.service3Desc: Compares the face on the document against the face captured live, to confirm it's the same person.
landing.service4Desc: Contrasts what was extracted from the document against the client's system, with semantic analysis — tolerates formatting differences, catches real mismatches.
landing.problemTitle: Building your own KYC takes months. Integrating someone else's takes weeks of contracts.
landing.problemWithoutDesc: Weeks choosing a biometrics provider, negotiating contracts, integrating separate native SDKs for web, iOS and Android — before verifying a single user.
landing.problemWithDesc: One URL. The user opens it in their browser, verifies, and your system receives the result via webhook — nothing to install.
landing.archTitle: Serverless end to end. You pay per verification, not for idle infrastructure.
landing.archMetric1Label: Managed AWS services — no servers to patch
landing.archMetric2Label: Independent functions, each with its own permission scope
landing.archMetric3Label: Client-side installs — everything runs in the browser
landing.securityTitle: Results travel signed. Your system verifies them before trusting them.
landing.securityTransportDetail: HTTPS enforced on every endpoint — no exceptions.
landing.securityAuthDetail: Every result notification is signed with HMAC-SHA256, verifiable by your system.
landing.securityIsolationDetail: Server-to-server — the end user's browser never touches your webhook.
landing.securityTenantDetail: Each client has their own branding, security thresholds and results channel.
landing.whatsappCalloutTitle: Your bot asks for the link. The user verifies. Your system replies on its own.
landing.whatsappCalloutDesc: The user never leaves WhatsApp — they get the link, complete verification in their browser, and your bot replies with the result as soon as it's done.
landing.finalTitle: Try all four services with real demo data.
landing.finalSub: No signup. No contract. Just open the link.
